paragraphs.s: Last March my friends and I (1) …………… some free time, so we decided to go abroad.
paragraphs.tr: 去年三月，我和朋友们有一些空闲时间，所以我们决定出国。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：my friends and I (1) ____ some free time, so we decided to go abroad.
parts: my friends and I —— 我和朋友们
…………… some free time —— 有一些空闲时间
so we decided to go abroad —— 所以决定出国
gram: have free time 有空闲时间
ana.tip: 「有时间」用 have → 1 had（B）。官方：1 B。

paragraphs.s: We (2) …………… a week in the wonderful city of Barcelona, seeing the sights, eating wonderful meals and (3) …………… some great shopping!
paragraphs.tr: 我们在美妙的巴塞罗那待了一周，看景点、吃美食，还大肆购物！

ana.frame: 主谓宾：We (2) ____ a week in the wonderful city of Barcelona … and (3) ____ some great shopping!
parts: in the wonderful city of Barcelona —— 在巴塞罗那
seeing the sights, eating wonderful meals —— 看景点、吃美食
…………… some great shopping —— 大肆购物
gram: spend a week 待一周；do some shopping 购物
ana.tip: 「度过一周」用 spend → 2 spent（D）；「购物」用 do → 3 doing（C）。官方：2 D / 3 C。

paragraphs.s: While we were there, we (4) …………… the underground train and then a cable car right to the top of Montjuïc Hill, where we (5) …………… the most amazing views across the city.
paragraphs.tr: 在那里时，我们坐了地铁，又坐缆车一直到蒙特惠奇山山顶，在那里看到了全城最壮观的景色。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：we (4) ____ the underground train and then a cable car … where we (5) …………… the most amazing views across the city.
parts: While we were there —— 我们在那里时
and then a cable car right to the top of Montjuïc Hill —— 然后坐缆车到山顶
where we (5) …………… the most amazing views across the city —— 在那里看到全城最美的景色
gram: take the underground 坐地铁；see the views 看景色
ana.tip: 「坐车」用 take → 4 took（A）；「看景色」用 see → 5 saw（A）。官方：4 A / 5 A。

paragraphs.s: Questions 21–26

paragraphs.s: For each question, choose the correct answer.
paragraphs.tr: 每题选出一个正确答案。

ana.frame: 祈使句：choose the correct answer（选出正确答案）
ana.tip: 先看空前后跟什么词，再选搭配得上的。

paragraphs.s: Many people think sheep aren't very intelligent creatures.
paragraphs.tr: 很多人认为羊不是很聪明的动物。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Many people think sheep aren't very intelligent creatures.
parts: sheep aren't very intelligent creatures —— 羊不是很聪明的动物
ana.tip: 开头是「大家以为」—— 后面会有反转。

paragraphs.s: But in fact, 【21】 to new research, they may be cleverer than we think.
paragraphs.tr: 但事实上，根据新研究，它们可能比我们想的更聪明。

ana.frame: 主系表：they may be cleverer than we think.
parts: 【21】 to new research —— 根据新研究
may be cleverer than we think —— 可能比我们想的更聪明
ana.tip: 只有 according 后面能接 to → 21 选 D according。官方：21 D。

paragraphs.s: For example, sheep can actually be trained to recognise human faces from photographs!
paragraphs.tr: 例如，羊其实可以被训练来从照片上识别人类的面孔！

ana.frame: 被动句：sheep can actually be trained to recognise human faces from photographs!
parts: can actually be trained —— 可以被训练
to recognise human faces from photographs —— 从照片识别人类面孔
clauses: 被动语态；be trained to do sth
ana.tip: 「识别面孔」—— 全文的主题句。

paragraphs.s: Recognising faces is an important human social 【22】.
paragraphs.tr: 识别面孔是一项重要的人类社交技能。

ana.frame: 主系表：Recognising faces is an important human social 【22】.
parts: an important human social 【22】 —— 一项重要的人类社交……」
ana.tip: 「社交技能」是固定说法 → 22 选 A skill。官方：22 A。

paragraphs.s: However, it seems that sheep are also social animals that can recognise other sheep as well as 【23】 humans.
paragraphs.tr: 然而，羊似乎也是社交动物，它们既能认出其他羊，也能认出熟悉的人类。

ana.frame: 主系表：it seems that sheep are also social animals …
parts: it seems that sheep are also social animals —— 羊似乎也是社交动物
that can recognise other sheep as well as 【23】 humans —— 能认出其他羊和……的人类
clauses: it seems that…；that 定语从句；as well as
ana.tip: 「熟悉的人类」（见过的面孔）→ 23 选 C familiar。官方：23 C。

paragraphs.s: In experiments, researchers trained eight sheep to recognise the faces of celebrities from photographs.
paragraphs.tr: 在实验中，研究人员训练了八只羊从照片上认出名人的面孔。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：researchers trained eight sheep to recognise the faces of celebrities from photographs.
parts: trained eight sheep —— 训练了八只羊
to recognise the faces of celebrities from photographs —— 从照片认出名人的面孔
ana.tip: 「名人的面孔」—— 实验的具体设定。

paragraphs.s: Training involved getting the sheep to 【24】 decisions about the photos they saw.
paragraphs.tr: 训练包括让羊对看到的照片做决定。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Training involved getting the sheep to 【24】 decisions about the photos they saw.
parts: getting the sheep to 【24】 decisions about the photos they saw —— 让羊对看到的照片做决定
ana.tip: 「做决定」用 make → 24 选 B make。官方：24 B。

paragraphs.s: At one end of a room, they would see two different photographs, and would receive a 【25】 of food for approaching the photograph of the celebrity; if they approached the wrong photograph, they got nothing.
paragraphs.tr: 在房间的一端，它们会看到两张不同的照片；走近名人照片会得到一份食物奖励；如果走近错误的照片，就什么也得不到。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：they would see two different photographs, and would receive a 【25】 of food …
parts: At one end of a room —— 在房间的一端
would see two different photographs —— 会看到两张照片
would receive a 【25】 of food for approaching the photograph of the celebrity —— 走近名人照片会得到一份食物……
if they approached the wrong photograph, they got nothing —— 走近错照片就什么都没有
ana.tip: 「一份食物奖励」→ 25 选 A reward。官方：25 A。

paragraphs.s: Over time, they learned to 【26】 getting food with the celebrity's photograph.
paragraphs.tr: 随着时间推移，它们学会了把得到食物和名人照片联系起来。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：they learned to 【26】 getting food with the celebrity's photograph.
parts: getting food with the celebrity's photograph —— 把得到食物和名人照片（联系起来）
gram: connect A with B 把 A 与 B 联系起来
ana.tip: 「把 A 和 B 联系起来」用 connect → 26 选 D connect。官方：26 D。

paragraphs.s: And after training, the sheep correctly chose the celebrity's face eight times out of ten!
paragraphs.tr: 训练之后，羊能十次中八次正确地选出名人的面孔！

ana.frame: 主谓宾：the sheep correctly chose the celebrity's face eight times out of ten!
parts: eight times out of ten —— 十次中八次
gram: out of ten 在十次中
ana.tip: 十次对八次 —— 实验成功的收尾。
